text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there are many shining lights in the Umamusume world, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That said, I believe the most dazzling of those lights belong to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Do you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And would you like to help that light grow?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now then, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright, you're not alone today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you remember our promise? That we would help the Mejiro family shine together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course I do, Dober. That's why you're running today too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. For the Mejiros. And…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to bring the Mejiros into the future, before you can!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah… What a splendid desire. Let's be on our way, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Together, we'll see all the other glittering stars outside of the Mejiro sphere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's Arima Kinen has a spectacular lineup of all-time high-class racers.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass, El, King, Sei! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's blow Bright and all our fans away with our incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Grass & El
text_block_list.text: Right. Sounds bueno to me!

text_block_list.name: King & Sky
text_block_list.text: Of course! All righty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Golden Generation. The young up-and-comers making waves throughout the racing world.
It's true that Umamusume can inherit strength, but that ability is not reserved for members of great racing families.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As for me, I am my mother's daughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And here I will show you all the strength that I've inherited from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, like the Mejiros, also hails from a proud line of racers.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I saw it in the stars! A present has arrived for you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright, your present is me! I'm the cherry on the sundae that is this race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But I'm feeling lucky today, so I might just snap up that victory instead. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru has a "luck" powerful enough to overcome speed, lineage, and any other factors that stand in her way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But who will emerge victorious after this incredible race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Regardless of the generation, the Mejiros have always been the object of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That will never change, and I shall prove it. My sisters of the past, please keep your eyes on me.
